signature: SUBROUTINE ZTPRFB( SIDE, TRANS, DIRECT, STOREV, M, N, K, L,

params.name: side
params.reference:
-   `= 'L'`: apply H or $H^H$ from the Left
-   `= 'R'`: apply H or $H^H$ from the Right

params.name: direct
params.reference:
Indicates how H is formed from a product of elementary reflectors

-   `= 'F'`: $H = H(1)$ H(2) . . . H(k) (Forward)
-   `= 'B'`: $H = H(k)$ . . . H(2) H(1) (Backward)

params.name: storev
params.reference:
Indicates how the vectors which define the elementary reflectors are stored:

-   `= 'C'`: Columns
-   `= 'R'`: Rows

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix B. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: K
params.reference: The order of the matrix T, i.e. the number of elementary reflectors whose product defines the block reflector. $K \ge 0$.

params.name: L
params.reference: The order of the trapezoidal part of V. $K \ge L \ge 0$. See Further Details.

params.name: V
params.reference: (`LDV`,M) if `STOREV = 'R'` and `SIDE = 'L'` (`LDV`,N) if `STOREV = 'R'` and `SIDE = 'R'` The pentagonal matrix V, which contains the elementary reflectors H(1), H(2), ..., H(K). See Further Details.

params.name: ldv
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array V. If `STOREV = 'C'` and `SIDE = 'L'`, $\mathrm{LDV} \ge \max (1,M)$; if `STOREV = 'C'` and `SIDE = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LDV} \ge \max (1,N)$; if `STOREV = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LDV} \ge K$.

params.name: T
params.reference: The triangular K-by-K matrix T in the representation of the block reflector.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge K$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the K-by-N or M-by-K matrix A. On exit, A is overwritten by the corresponding block of $H \, C$ or $H^H \, C$ or $C \, H$ or $C \, H^H$. See Further Details.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,K)$; If `SIDE = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix B. On exit, B is overwritten by the corresponding block of $H \, C$ or $H^H \, C$ or $C \, H$ or $C \, H^H$. See Further Details.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: ldwork
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `WORK`. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $\mathrm{LDWORK} \ge K$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LDWORK} \ge M$.
